feed.title: Decoded365: new and updated terms
feed.subtitle: A community glossary for Microsoft 365: SharePoint, Power Platform and Copilot.

entry.title: New: Access control entry
entry.summary: An access control entry is one line on a guest list: it names a person or group and says what they may or may not do with something.

entry.title: New: Access control list
entry.summary: An access control list is the full guest list for a door: every person or group and what each is allowed to do.

entry.title: New: Access URL
entry.summary: An access URL is the address the search robot uses to reach a file or page when it collects information for search.

entry.title: New: Activity feed
entry.summary: An activity feed is like a news ticker of what the people, documents and topics you follow have been up to.

entry.title: New: Activity flow
entry.summary: An activity flow is a recipe being followed right now, one step after another.

entry.title: New: Activity model
entry.summary: An activity model is a ready-made routine, like a saved checklist of steps that you can reuse.

entry.title: New: Adaptive Card
entry.summary: An Adaptive Card is a small, tidy panel with text, pictures and buttons that appears inside a chat, like a mini form.

entry.title: New: After event
entry.summary: An after event is like a thank-you note sent once a job has finished.

entry.title: New: Agent 365
entry.summary: Agent 365 is a control panel for the AI agents an organisation uses, so someone can see them and keep them in check.

entry.title: New: Agentic AI
entry.summary: Agentic AI is AI that can work through several steps to reach a goal, instead of just answering one question.

entry.title: New: AI model
entry.summary: An AI model is the trained "brain" inside an AI tool: it has learned patterns from lots of examples and uses them to produce an answer.

entry.title: New: AI safety
entry.summary: AI safety is the set of habits and controls that stop an AI from causing harm or doing something unexpected.

entry.title: New: AI-generated content
entry.summary: AI-generated content is anything an AI wrote or made for you: text, images, summaries, code and so on.

entry.title: New: Alert subscription
entry.summary: An alert subscription is a request that says: tell me by message whenever this thing changes.

entry.title: New: Alternate account
entry.summary: An alternate account is a second login for the same person, kept in a different place from their main one.

entry.title: New: Analyst
entry.summary: Analyst is a ready-made Copilot helper that is good at working with numbers and data.

entry.title: New: App context
entry.summary: App context is what Copilot can see about the thing you have open, such as the current document or email.

entry.title: New: App custom action
entry.summary: An app custom action is an extra button added to a site by an add-in, and it leads to more of that add-in's features.

entry.title: New: App part
entry.summary: An app part is a window on a page that shows a small piece of an add-in.

entry.title: New: Application directory
entry.summary: The application directory is a folder on a search server where its working files for search are kept.

entry.title: New: Application session
entry.summary: An application session is the time an application is open: it starts when you open it and ends when you close it.

entry.title: New: Audience identifier
entry.summary: An audience identifier is the unique name tag that tells SharePoint which audience you mean.

entry.title: New: Audience rule
entry.summary: An audience rule is the entry test for a club: if you meet the conditions, you are in.

entry.title: New: Authentication
entry.summary: Authentication is proving who you are, like showing your pass at the entrance.

entry.title: New: Authorisation
entry.summary: Authorisation decides what a person, Copilot or an agent is allowed to do once it is known who they are.

entry.title: New: Authoritative page
entry.summary: An authoritative page is a web page an administrator has marked as especially trustworthy, so search shows it nearer the top.

entry.title: New: Authority level
entry.summary: The authority level is a score that says how important a page is: 0 is the best.

entry.title: New: Autohost
entry.summary: Autohost means the system puts the pieces of an add-in in the right places for you.

entry.title: New: Autopilot
entry.summary: Autopilot is an AI helper that lives in your organisation and keeps working on its own between your requests, like a colleague with a standing job.

entry.title: New: Available site template
entry.summary: An available site template is a layout you are allowed to pick when you create a new site.

entry.title: New: Azure AI Foundry
entry.summary: Azure AI Foundry is Microsoft's workshop in the cloud for building, testing and running AI applications and agents.

entry.title: New: Background task
entry.summary: A background task is work an agent keeps doing while you get on with something else.

entry.title: New: Backward signing
entry.summary: Backward signing describes how a handwritten signature runs: from left to right, or the other way round.

entry.title: New: Base view identifier
entry.summary: The base view identifier is the number that picks out one saved way of looking at a list.

entry.title: New: Basic page
entry.summary: A basic page is a simple, plain page where one area can hold a piece of content.

entry.title: New: BCS solution deployment
entry.summary: BCS solution deployment is the process of getting a business-data solution from the server onto people's computers.

entry.title: New: Before event
entry.summary: A before event is a checkpoint that you must pass before the action can go ahead.

entry.title: New: Blank site
entry.summary: A blank site is an empty room: a new site with nothing set up in it yet.

entry.title: New: Bring your own data
entry.summary: Bring your own data means plugging your organisation's own information into an AI tool so its answers fit your business.

entry.title: New: Browser context
entry.summary: Browser context is the web page you are looking at, shared with an AI helper when you allow it.

entry.title: New: Business Chat
entry.summary: Business Chat is an older name for the Copilot chat that could draw on your work information across apps.

entry.title: New: Business Connectivity Services
entry.summary: Business Connectivity Services lets you bring data from other business systems into SharePoint and Office, so people can use it without leaving those tools.

entry.title: New: Business data
entry.summary: Business data is the information a company holds about its work: documents, emails, meetings, reports and records.

entry.title: New: Business process
entry.summary: A business process is a repeatable set of steps that gets a job done, like approving an expense.

entry.title: New: Business system
entry.summary: A business system is a company's main working software, such as customer, finance or HR systems.

entry.title: New: CAML
entry.summary: CAML is a small XML language SharePoint uses to describe things like queries and views, a bit like a form with fixed boxes to fill in.

entry.title: New: Central Administration site
entry.summary: Central Administration is the control room of a SharePoint installation, where an administrator manages everything from one place.

entry.title: New: Chrome control
entry.summary: The chrome control draws the top bar of a page so that an add-in looks like it belongs inside SharePoint.

entry.title: New: Citation
entry.summary: A citation is a pointer in an answer that shows where a statement came from, like a footnote.

entry.title: New: Content migration package
entry.summary: A content migration package is a box of files used to move content from one place to another.
